winner.text: Train the additive five-field scorer with a within-user pairwise logistic ranking loss instead of pointwise BCE.
winner.rationale: The official objective is entirely within-user ranking, while the current pointwise BCE model has GAUC 0.6689116170510226 but lower nDCG@5 of 0.5369580777053825. A pairwise objective directly targets positive-negative ordering without introducing unapproved features.
winner.exact_ablation: Replace pointwise BCE with a within-user positive-versus-negative logistic pairwise loss, keeping the additive five-field scorer, data, optimizer family, regularization, and stopping procedure unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by 0.001 to 0.004 because each update directly rewards within-user positive-negative ordering.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by 0.000 to 0.003 if improved pairwise ordering transfers to the first five positions; the effect may be smaller than GAUC.

selection_rationale: Select c02: it preserves the proven additive five-field representation, directly aligns training with the official within-user ranking objective, has low leakage risk, and is the Consultant's top-ranked non-duplicate candidate. Its expected primary gain (0.002) and moderate runtime risk are preferable to novelty-heavy interaction or listwise alternatives; c01 is a known duplicate and should not consume the scarce experiment.
